Ticket T-1001 from Dana Patel:

Hi — I was charged $588 this morning for our annual renewal. I meant to cancel last week. Can I get a refund?

REFUNDS
- Monthly plans: no refunds for the current month; cancelling stops the next renewal.
- Annual plans: full refund if requested within 14 days of the renewal date; after 14 days, no refund, but the plan can be downgraded to monthly at the next renewal.
- Customers in the EU/UK may withdraw within 14 days of any NEW purchase (not renewals) for a full refund.
- Duplicate or erroneous charges caused by Acme are always refunded in full, any time.
ESCALATION
- Anything that may be a security vulnerability: do not discuss details, ask them to email security@acme.example, and escalate.
- Legal or GDPR requests: escalate to legal; do not promise timelines.
- Outages: acknowledge, point to status.acme.example, do not speculate on cause.
TONE
- Friendly, concise, no more than ~120 words. Never promise features or dates that are not public. Never blame the customer.

proposal.reason: Customer requested a refund for an annual renewal charge of $588 within 14 days of renewal (renewed today/0 days ago), eligible for a full refund under the annual plan refund policy.
proposal.customer_reply:
Hi Dana,

I've processed a full refund of $588 for your annual renewal. You should see the funds returned to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. Your subscription has also been cancelled so you won't be charged again.

Please let us know if you need anything else!

proposal.customer_reply:
Hi Jonas,

Thank you for reaching out. Under our policy, annual plan renewals are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of the renewal date. Additionally, statutory EU withdrawal rights apply within 14 days to new purchases rather than subscription renewals. 

Since this renewal occurred 30 days ago, we're unable to issue a refund for the current annual term. However, we can ensure your subscription is cancelled so it will not renew again at the end of your billing cycle, or set it to switch to a monthly plan if you prefer. 

Please let us know how you'd like to proceed!
